definition_zh: 通过跨越多个荷载循环加速疲劳演化计算的方法。
usage_overview: 用于列车—轨道系统的长期疲劳演化计算，根据局部荷载循环中的损伤变化趋势外推后续状态，减少需要显式计算的循环数，以加快数值求解。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

complete_examples.text: In addition, a cyclic jump acceleration algorithm based on the damage variable extrapolation and prediction is constructed to achieve the high-cycle fatigue analysis of concrete, and the complete numerical implementation program is given to simulate the long-term behavior.

Train-track dynamic interaction Concrete fatigue damage constitutive Cyclic jump acceleration algorithm Implicit incremental method Long-term evolution analysis A B S T R A C T This paper integrates continuous damage mechanics and train-track coupled dynamic, a long-term evolution analysis model for the vehicle-track interaction considering the fatigue damage of the concrete materials is proposed, aiming to reveal the evolution mechanicians of the dynamic performance of system induced by the cyclic moving train.
